user.title: Hinen Solar Advanced
user.description:
Apply for your own Client ID and Client Secret on the Hinen Developer Portal: {portal_url}

Enter the redirect address as the base URL of this Home Assistant instance (no trailing slash). After you submit, you'll be sent to Hinen to choose your region and sign in.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Hinen Solar Advanced
reauth_confirm.description: Your Hinen authorization needs to be renewed. Select Submit to sign in again.
